objective: Replan W1 v3 verification only. Preserve the already-applied 9-file W1 source patch exactly. Rerun the same hardened oracle using cmd.exe to merge native stdout/stderr before PowerShell sees it: prove all five source symbols exist, enumerate cargo tests and require exactly one match for each of the four required regression names, run each resolved full test path with --exact, then cargo fmt --check and cargo check.
